title: CheckMyCoach Evaluation Result
description: Complete provenance record for one case x one condition x one attempt.

model_id.description: Model identifier (e.g. openai/gpt-4o-mini). 'N/A (no API call)' for original.

temperature.description: LLM temperature parameter. null for original condition.

max_tokens.description: Maximum output tokens. null for original condition.

fallback_status.description: Fallback indicator. 'N/A' for original/CMC, 'llm' for successful generic call.

prompt_hash.description: SHA-256 prefix of the prompt sent to the LLM. Empty for original condition.

evidence_hash.description: SHA-256 prefix of the evidence payload serialization.

included.description: true if the condition completed successfully. false on any API/parse/pipeline failure.

error.description: Error message if included=false. null if included=true.

raw_response.description: Original pre-provided answer (same across all three conditions)

corrected_response.description: Corrected answer after condition processing. null for original.

evidence_ids.description: Evidence object IDs used. Populated for generic and CMC.

correction_trace.description: Trace from the correction stage (generic or CMC)

needs_calibration.description: Whether M1 flagged as needing calibration (CMC only)
